Name: Bubbles
DevComment: T-027 PLACEHOLDER numbers (tune after Jimmy's playtest). Feeding fish: rarer (luck), a bit bigger, worth more, and they bite sooner. Any water at least 60 cm deep. The struct defaults in FLureHotSpotRow must equal this row (the built-in fallback).

Name: Ripples
DevComment: T-027 PLACEHOLDER numbers. Big fish moving under the surface: much bigger fish, a little luck. Reef, lagoon and deep water only, at least 90 cm deep; wanders farther and faster than bubbles.
